items.statement: write_bw enters GID handling through set_up_connection, which queries an explicit user index directly or invokes automatic selection when gid_index is set but use_gid_user is false.
Automatic setup scans the port GID table, scores each valid entry, stores the first strictly highest-scoring index, and queries that selected GID for the local destination.
When use_gid_user is set, setup queries the configured GID index directly instead of entering the automatic-selection else branch.
When use_gid_user is clear, setup replaces gid_index with the best scored table index and queries that selected GID.
Parameters start with gid_index=-1 and use_gid_user=0; Ethernet detection changes an unset index to 0 to enable GID handling, and automatic setup replaces it with the selected table index.
write_bw opens the verbs device context, allocates local and remote destination arrays and test resources before setup, and routes setup failure through context destruction and memory release.
Automatic selection scans indices from zero through gid_tbl_len minus one and preserves the earlier index when scores tie because replacement requires a strictly greater score.
The -x GID index is range-checked as a uint8_t before use_gid_user is enabled.
In dual-port mode, setup repeats explicit or automatic GID selection for the second port, and QPs are partitioned so the latter half uses that port's selected GID index.
compute_gid_score returns -1 when querying a GID table entry fails.
compute_gid_score returns -1 when the queried GID is all zero.
Automatic setup returns -1 when best-index selection finds no valid GID table entry.
Automatic setup returns -1 when querying the selected GID on the primary port fails.
Dual-port automatic setup returns -1 when querying the selected GID on the secondary port fails.
For RoCE source-GID selection, each candidate is evaluated by IP-family match and link-local scope, with its queried GID type adding a lower-weight version preference in which RoCE v2 outranks v1.
items.description: Automatic GID selection scores supported RoCE versions with v2 preferred over v1; setup queries a user-selected GID directly when use_gid_user is set, otherwise it selects the best scored GID index and fails when no valid index or GID can be queried.
